title: Require Recipe Step Runtime Owner Shape
forbids: recipe step step.ts modules without one semantically named *Step = createStep(config, ...) executable, with additional runtime exports or re-exports, or with a default export
why: A recipe step runtime owner imports its literal local config contract and exposes one semantically named *Step executable as its public runtime identity. Local helpers and erased type/interface exports remain available without creating competing exported runtime surfaces. Exact step.ts acquisition selects the kind, Core's createStep contract owns constructor admission, and Knip owns unused private construction.
remediate: Import config from ./config.js, retain one documented <Name>Step = createStep(config, ...) export, keep non-authority helpers local, and delete default or additional runtime exports and re-exports.
message: Recipe step step.ts must expose only its semantically named *Step executable over the local config contract.
